title: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers continues its progress on the Maui wildfires recovery effort
description: Since debris removal within Lahaina began Jan. 17, USACE and its contractors have cleared 1,191 of the approximate 1,339 residential properties it has contracted to clear. This includes 681 residential lots that have been returned to the county of Maui allowing homeowners to begin the rebuilding process. In addition to the residential properties, USACE has also cleared 42 commercial lots of ash and debris.

transcript.text: The US . Army Corps of Engineers
continues its progress in support of
the Maui wildfires recovery effort .
There are currently about 109 core
employees in Maui supporting a variety
of missions including debris removal .
The work is funded by federal emergency
management agency supporting the state
of Hawaii and the county of Maui .
Since debris removal began January 17th ,
the Corps and its contractors have
cleared 1191 of the approximate
1339 residential properties .
This includes 681 residential lots that
have been returned to the county of
Maui allowing homeowners to begin the
rebuilding process . In addition to the
residential properties , the core has
also cleared 42 commercial lots of ash
and debris . Other debris removal
efforts include more than 2632
vehicles that have been removed from
the impacted area and brought to
pioneer mill for processing by county
officials .
